name: search_meals
description: Search TheMealDB for recipes by meal name. Returns full recipe details — category, cuisine area, ingredients with measurements, step-by-step instructions, tags, thumbnail, and YouTube/source URLs.

query.description: Meal name or partial name to search for

name: get_meal
description: Get complete recipe details including ingredients with measurements and step-by-step cooking instructions. Pass a meal ID from search_meals or random_meal.

name: random_meal
description: Get a random meal recipe with full ingredients and cooking instructions. Use when you need recipe inspiration without a specific search.

name: meals_by_ingredient
description: Find all recipes using a specific ingredient (e.g., "chicken", "garlic", "pasta"). Returns meal names and IDs to pass to get_meal.
